description: This file implements a Kubernetes controller for managing EndpointSlices, including event handling, synchronization, and topology management.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Manages Kubernetes EndpointSlice resources, handling event processing, synchronization, and topology updates.

methods.name: NewController
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new EndpointSlice Controller with informers, queues, and event handlers.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller's worker threads and runs until the context is canceled.

methods.name: serviceQueueWorker
methods.description: Worker loop processing service-related work items.

methods.name: processNextServiceWorkItem
methods.description: Processes a single service work item from the queue.

methods.name: topologyQueueWorker
methods.description: Worker loop processing topology-related work items.

methods.name: processNextTopologyWorkItem
methods.description: Processes a single topology work item from the queue.

methods.name: handleErr
methods.description: Handles errors during service sync, implementing retries and dropping after max retries.

methods.name: syncService
methods.description: Synchronizes EndpointSlices for a specific service based on current state.

methods.name: podQueueWorker
methods.description: Worker loop processing pod-related work items.

methods.name: processNextPodWorkItem
methods.description: Processes a single pod work item from the queue.

methods.name: handlePodErr
methods.description: Handles errors during pod sync, implementing retries.

methods.name: syncPod
methods.description: Syncs endpoint slices related to a specific pod.

methods.name: onServiceUpdate
methods.description: Enqueues service for processing upon update.

methods.name: onServiceDelete
methods.description: Enqueues service for processing upon deletion.

methods.name: onPodUpdate
methods.description: Enqueues pod for processing upon update or delete.

methods.name: onEndpointSliceAdd
methods.description: Handles addition of EndpointSlice objects.

methods.name: onEndpointSliceUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to EndpointSlice objects.

methods.name: onEndpointSliceDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of EndpointSlice objects.

methods.name: queueServiceForEndpointSlice
methods.description: Queues the service associated with a given EndpointSlice for sync.

methods.name: addNode
methods.description: Handles node addition events.

methods.name: updateNode
methods.description: Handles node update events, especially topology changes.

methods.name: deleteNode
methods.description: Handles node deletion events.

methods.name: checkNodeTopologyDistribution
methods.description: Updates topology cache and queues overloaded services.

methods.name: trackSync
methods.description: Records metrics for EndpointSlice sync operations.

methods.name: dropEndpointSlicesPendingDeletion
methods.description: Filters out EndpointSlices marked for deletion.

methods.name: getEndpointSliceFromDeleteAction
methods.description: Extracts EndpointSlice object from delete event.

methods.name: isNodeReady
methods.description: Checks if a node is in Ready condition.
